test_title: SSC CGL Tier 2 Quant Previous Year Paper (Held On: 3 Feb 2022)
subject: general
question: P and Q start a shop with a capital of Rs. 1,50,000 and Rs. 4,50,000, respectively. After a year, out of the profit of Rs. 2,00,000, P gets his share of profit plus some money as his salary that is not a part of the profit. If P gets a total of Rs. 90,000, what is the amount of salary (in Rs.) that he received?
solution:
The correct answer is __**40,000**__
**__Key Points__**
__

• To find the amount of salary, we must first calculate the **Profit Sharing Ratio** between **P** and **Q** based on their initial investments.

• The **Capital** invested by **P** is **Rs. 1,50,000** and by **Q** is **Rs. 4,50,000**.

• The **Investment Ratio** (P : Q) = 1,50,000 : 4,50,000 = 15 : 45 = **1 : 3**.

• Since both partners invested for the same duration (one year), the **Total Profit** of **Rs. 2,00,000** is divided in the same ratio as their capital (**1 : 3**).

• The total number of parts in the ratio is 1 + 3 = **4 parts**.

• The share of profit for **P** = (1 / 4) multiplied by 2,00,000 = **Rs. 50,000**.

• The problem states that **P** receives a total of **Rs. 90,000**, which consists of his share of the profit plus a **Salary** that is not included in the profit pool.

• Total Amount Received by **P** = **Profit Share** + **Salary**.

• 90,000 = 50,000 + **Salary**.

• **Salary** = 90,000 − 50,000 = **Rs. 40,000**.

**Additional Information__**

• In a **Partnership**, if the time period of investment is the same for all partners, the profit is distributed directly in the ratio of their **Capitals**.

• If the time periods are different, the profit ratio is calculated as (**Capital 1** multiplied by **Time 1**) : (**Capital 2** multiplied by **Time 2**).

• A **Working Partner** is a partner who actively manages the business and may receive extra compensation, such as a **Salary** or a **Commission**, in addition to their share of the profit.

• A **Sleeping Partner** is one who only invests money but does not take part in the daily operations of the business.
